resources.string: Three distinct days: volume, light technique and a top set. Trace adaptation: no 0.5 kg increases or automatic 1RM tests. 12 sessions cover four regular weeks.

Volume block · 4–6 reps. Progression uses the lowest rep count.
Top set · 4–6 reps. Your result sets next week’s heavy weight.
Heavy block · 3 sets of 3 reps.
Volume → technique → top set. Increases of 1.25 or 2.5 kg follow confirmed results.
Set starting weights

Initial loads: heavy 80% of 1RM, volume 65%, light 70% of heavy. Round down to 1.25 kg. Heavy and light loads then change by the same amount after the top-set day; volume progresses independently using the lowest reps. 6+ reps: +2.5 kg; 5: +1.25 kg; 4 or fewer: hold. Top-day backoffs: −15 kg for pull-ups, −20 kg for dips, floored at 0 kg. This adaptation omits microplates and monthly 1RM tests.
